entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to start a return for an order.
Certainly, I can help you with that. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. Look, I just need to know if I can send it back. Yes or no.

Okay, one moment while I pull that up... I see the order for the ProFit Jersey, delivered on December 26th. To make sure I process this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's the wrong size. The jersey is way too tight. I want to return it, or maybe do an exchange for a large.
I understand completely. Not a problem. I've checked the policy for you, and since the jersey is a standard apparel item, it's covered by our 90-day return window. You're well within that timeframe.
Great. So you can approve it?
Yes, absolutely. I've just authorized the return. I am sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file right now. You can use that to send the item back for a full refund.
Okay, I see the email. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
